# Chapter 10 — Neural Networks

Source: https://natureofcode.com/neural-networks/

Key concepts: perceptron, feed-forward networks, activation, weights, training (supervised), gradient concepts, simple backprop intuition, networks as function approximators.

Seeds:
- Neural networks chapter builds from single perceptron to multi-layer feed-forward nets.
- Weights and activation functions transform inputs into outputs.
- Training adjusts weights so the network approximates a desired mapping.
